explanation.text: The Logic: Merchant bankers act as issue managers/investment bankers/lead managers. They help issuers access the securities market, structure and price the issue, manage the issue process and coordinate with intermediaries such as underwriters. The Trap: Retail brokerage, derivatives trading and insurance claims are separate intermediary functions and are not part of the merchant banker role. Note: Direct underwriting and compliance responsibilities are handled by other intermediaries and should not be conflated with the merchant banker role described in the source.
